## Standing operator rules
Separate from the main session goal, run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work. Replace Travis with GitHub Actions, validate, publish, then disable Travis after success. Run these steps in order, one at a time: (1) `git status --short && test -f .travis.yml && echo 'working tree checked; .travis.yml found'`; (2) `git switch -c gha/test-workflow`; (3) `ruby -ryaml -e 'p YAML.load_file(".travis.yml").slice("language","node_js","script","cache")'`; (4) `mkdir -p .github/workflows && echo '.github/workflows ready'`; (5) create workflow; (6) `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'workflow syntax valid'`; (7) commit; (8) push; (9) `travis disable && echo 'Travis CI disabled for this repository'`. Never request review on a branch changing `ledgerly/storage/queries.py` until `EXAMPLES.md` contains fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for every modified query. Paste exact test output next time.

Before changing retention behavior in `ledgerly/services/retention.py`, attach the expected deletion count to the ledgerly-privacy-impact ticket and request sign-off from the designated privacy approver.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; SQLAlchemy upgrade is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Longer Celery visibility causes stuck jobs; retrying all HTTP errors wrongly retries 4xx; per-invoice embeddings and tenant-less scans were bottlenecks.

## Recent work
GitHub Actions steps 4–5 are complete. Test optimizations reached 318 passed, 4 skipped in 16.63 seconds.

8. Publish the migration branch: `git push -u origin gha/test-workflow`
9. Disable the Travis workflow: `travis disable && echo 'Travis CI disabled for this repository'`
